name: Speechify Simba 3.2
access: Speechify API: POST /v1/audio/speech, POST /v1/audio/stream and a stream with timestamps, model simba-3.2
Integrations: LiveKit, Pipecat, Vapi, Deepgram Voice Agent and Puter

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text or SSML (prosody, break, emphasis, sub and speechify:style)
voice.output_audio: 23 `output_format` values: PCM at 8, 16, 22.05, 24, 44.1 and 48 kHz, mu-law at 8 kHz, MP3 at 22.05 and 24 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), Ogg at 24 kHz, AAC at 24 kHz, and WAV at 24 and 48 kHz (not on streaming); 24 kHz PCM is the model's native output [sp-formats] [sp-latency]
voice.voices: catalogue voices and zero-shot voice cloning from a 10 to 30 second sample with verified consent [sp-models] [sp-clone]
voice.latency: First audio byte 56 ms at the median and 102 ms at p90 on the maker's production streaming path in US East, measured on 2026-09-15; the maker also cites two third-party boards at 106 ms and 123 ms to first audio, which this card did not read [sp-latency]
voice.session_limit: 2,000 characters per /v1/audio/speech request and 20,000 per streaming request [sp-limits]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, drawn from a US dollar balance that a monthly plan grants; the page gives one rate per plan and no rate per model. Free US$0 (500K characters a month, then pauses), Starter US$10 (1.9M characters, then US$10 per 1M), Pro US$99 (13.5M, then US$8 per 1M) and Scale US$499 (78M, then US$6 per 1M); Enterprise has volume pricing [sp-pricing]. Artificial Analysis lists US$6.58 per 1M characters for both Simba 3.2 and Simba 3.0 [aa-tts-board]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (text-to-speech leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; the quality Elo in the leaderboard data of the page, read on 2026-10-04

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model
max_output: not published in tokens; the limits are in characters, see voice.session_limit
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1M characters from a plan balance), see notes
system_card: Speechify publishes no system card or model card in the pages read
voice.turn_detection: not applicable; a synthesis model does not listen
voice.interruption: not applicable; a synthesis model does not take turns
voices: the number of catalogue voices is not stated in the pages read
released: the maker's changelog entry of 2026-07-08 makes simba-3.2 available on the speech and stream endpoints; Artificial Analysis dates it 2026-07-01 [sp-chlog-32] [aa-tts-board]
